items.html: However, in the rest of the Partzufim below Arich Anpin, their Bina was able to stand at the head of the Partzuf. The reason is that the light of Atik is the greatest light of all of Atzilut, since the light of Ein Sof clothes within it, as above. And since Atik has already clothed within Arich Anpin, the light diminished greatly, and when AVI return again to clothe Arich Anpin as well, the light of Atik is found to be very distant from them. Their Bina is therefore able to receive the light of Atik after being at a distance, even while sitting at the head of the Partzuf, and all the more so in ZON, which are even more distant.
